subject.title: feat: let plugin tools yield turns

question: Should OpenClaw adopt `AgentToolResult.control` plus `yieldToolResult(...)` as the supported public Plugin SDK contract for plugin-owned asynchronous turn handoff?
rationale: Correctness and proof establish that the implementation works, but they cannot decide whether this additive public API is the long-term plugin contract or should remain host-internal pending broader structured-interaction design.

options.title: Approve the narrow yield contract
options.body: Accept the yield-only result control because it atomically follows a successful tool result and reuses the existing host-owned session-yield lifecycle.

options.title: Keep the seam internal
options.body: Remove the public result field and helper, then expose a different host-owned plugin capability after the broader interaction API is designed.

options.title: Pause for structured interactions
options.body: Hold this PR until the adjacent structured-question work establishes whether both capabilities should share one public contract.

recommendation.title: Approve the narrow yield contract
recommendation.body: Accept the yield-only result control because it atomically follows a successful tool result and reuses the existing host-owned session-yield lifecycle.

likelyOwner.reason: The choice governs a durable public Plugin SDK and core agent-runtime boundary rather than a mechanical implementation detail.
